resources.string: Create a separate password-protected file using authenticated AES-256-GCM. The original is kept. Use at least 8 characters when encrypting. Your password is not saved; losing it means losing access.

Telos uses its own encrypted file format, not an encrypted ZIP. Existing files are never overwritten. A power loss while saving the result can leave an incomplete output file; keep the original until you verify the result.
Could not complete the operation. Check the password, file integrity, available storage and write permission. The original has been kept.
